title: How to Choose the Right AI Tool for Everyday Work
excerpt: A simple way to find AI tools that solve real problems instead of adding more complexity to your day.
body:
## Start with the task, not the trend
AI tools are appearing everywhere. Start by identifying a task that takes too much time.

## Test before committing
Try a small, low-risk task first and check the quality of the result.

## The takeaway
Choose tools based on practical value.

title: 5 Simple Ways to Improve Your Digital Workflow
excerpt: Small improvements to task lists, file names, templates, and routines can make daily work easier to manage.
body:
## 1. Keep tasks in one place
Choose one trusted task list.

## 2. Use clear file names
A consistent name makes documents easier to find.

## 3. Create reusable templates
Prepare a checklist or template for repeated tasks.

## Conclusion
Start with one change, keep it simple, and continue with habits that help.

title: A Beginner’s Checklist for Trying New Digital Services Safely
excerpt: Before creating an account or uploading files, check privacy, security, pricing, and data handling.
body:
## Check the source
Use the official website or app store listing.

## Understand the data you share
Do not share passwords or private documents in tools you do not trust.

## Secure your account
Use a unique password and multi-factor authentication when available.
